summary.zh-tw: 古寧頭戰役在海峽兩岸有不同的歷史定位與政治詮釋。雙方對戰役意義的敘事差異反映了更深層的政治立場。
summary.en: The Battle of Guningtou holds different historical and political significance on each side of the Taiwan Strait, reflecting deeper political narratives.

roc.zh-tw: 古寧頭戰役是「台海第一戰」，成功阻止解放軍渡海，確保了台澎金馬的安全。此役被定位為中華民國保衛戰的關鍵轉折點。
roc.en: The battle is framed as the 'First Battle of the Taiwan Strait' — a decisive victory that prevented PLA invasion and secured Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu.

pla.zh-tw: 解放軍將此役視為一次「局部失利」。毛澤東曾批示「此次失利，主要是輕敵」。此役後解放軍暫緩渡海作戰，轉而加強海空軍建設。
pla.en: The PLA views the battle as a 'local setback.' Mao reportedly commented: 'This defeat was primarily due to underestimating the enemy.' The PLA subsequently paused cross-strait operations and focused on naval and air force development.

disputes.zh-tw: 台灣：保衛戰關鍵勝利。中國大陸：渡海戰役的一次失利
disputes.en: Taiwan: key defensive victory. Mainland China: a failed amphibious operation.

disputes.zh-tw: 國軍：古寧頭經驗成為台海防衛的典範。解放軍：促使解放軍改革兩棲作戰能力
disputes.en: ROC: Guningtou became the model for Taiwan Strait defense. PLA: spurred reform of amphibious warfare capabilities.
